audio_description:
A descent through the D-District Prison's grim interior — rusted machinery and pipes.
Numbered cell hatches line the towering shaft.
A small caged lift sinks down the vast cylindrical core.

context.scene_title: Inside the D-District Prison (Desert Prison) — the party's imprisonment at the start of Disc 2, after the failed assassination.
locations: The dark mechanical interior of the Galbadian D-District Prison — a vast cylindrical tower of cells, pipes and machinery with a cage/lift descending its central shaft

characters.name: (none individually visible)
characters.recognition: Interior architectural FMV; numbered cell panels and the descending lift are shown, but no character's face is featured.

context.summary: A descent through the grim interior of the D-District Prison: rusted, numbered cell hatches and heavy machinery line a towering shaft, and a small caged lift sinks down the vast cylindrical core ringed with ornate mechanisms. It establishes the Galbadian desert prison where Squall's party is held.
context.context_note: High confidence: interior of the D-District (Desert) Prison; companion exterior shots appear in the following clips.
